headline: One WAN test is lossy end to end while both end routers and their syslog are clean; the fault sits between them and an incident for it has been open six weeks.
next_action: Health Device: Run the network device health check only. Scope: device:<wan-edge> device:<cloud-edge>

thousandeyes.trend_note: Three visits on the ring; the lossy row has held the same loss band since the baseline, the other test has stayed clean.
thousandeyes.impression: One test between <wan-edge> and <cloud-edge> is degraded on loss with no error rounds; the reverse-direction test is clean. This is a one-way path problem, not an agent outage.
evidence_for: board row test:<test-id> state degraded, loss_pct steady in one band
evidence_against: the paired test from <cloud-edge> completed every round with no loss
thousandeyes.inspect_when: Open when per-round error types or the alert list are needed.

splunk.trend_note: Two visits; per-device counts flat, no bgp or link row reached the flap threshold.
splunk.impression: Syslog is quiet on both end routers. This plane neither explains nor contradicts the path loss; it rules out a flapping link or session at either end.
evidence_for: no bgp or link row with count >= 2 on <wan-edge> or <cloud-edge>
no config row in the window
splunk.inspect_when: Open when mnemonic samples or auth events are needed.

iosxe.trend_note: One visit on the ring since the board was reset; no baseline for counters yet.
iosxe.impression: Interfaces up, BGP established, error counters flat on both end routers at the last visit — which is older than the TE symptom by 18 hours.
evidence_for: board rows for <wan-edge> and <cloud-edge> interfaces oper up, bgp established
in_errors and in_crc_errors 0 on the WAN-facing interfaces
evidence_against: the last device visit predates the TE degraded rounds seen since
iosxe.inspect_when: Open when per-interface counters or ACL hit counts are needed.

servicenow.trend_note: Two visits; three open incidents, none moved, no change requests.
servicenow.impression: An incident naming both end routers for this loss has been open six weeks with no change attached; a second incident describes the same symptom generically.
evidence_for: incident:<inc-a> names device:<wan-edge> and device:<cloud-edge> in its title, state In Progress
incident:<inc-c> describes chronic loss on the same pair
evidence_against: no change request or rfc on any row
servicenow.inspect_when: Open when the nurse's per-ticket notes are needed.

ticket_history.pattern: Long-open network incidents with no change attached; one carries typed device fields, two do not.
ticket_history.summary: Two incidents describe the WAN loss this chart sees; neither has progressed in the window. One unrelated provisioning ticket is open with typed device fields.
